title: s10 m2 (sign-off, v8 x12 picture, 835 frames = 27.833 s): music treatment per conspiracy m4c
notes: Treatment = conspiracy m4c (film/conspiracy 70fecfa, music-m4.py): cue mono fold, high-pass 100 Hz, high shelves 6 kHz -6 dB and 11 kHz -8 dB, normalised to -18 LUFS; under speech the cue sits at -29.3 LUFS (m4c's '+9'), 5 dB higher between words; sidechain from the dialogue (10 ms RMS key -44..-38 dBFS, 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release); no breakpoints, swells, dips, guard trim or minimum-gap logic. Program -16 LUFS, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP before AAC (finish-m3.py); AAC 192k on master and phone.

Plan unchanged from s10-m1 (df9a629): news bed (suno-2-breaking-news-a) at speed 1, bar 20's stab onset on 27.60 (just after the last word), so bar 7 enters at 1.144 s under the WE NOW RETURN wipe going out; cosine fade 27.70-28.05; the music stem rings 0.30 s past the picture for the stitch; the scene mix cuts it at 27.833 with a 15 ms fade.
m1's breakpoints (-14 in the 6.48-7.31 gap, -12 for the stab from 27.59) are gone: the sidechain alone sets the level, so the stab after the last word plays at the open level (-24.3 LUFS cue).
Start: the bed enters under the wipe going out (masked join, jingle A over it), before the first word (1.86); not moved.
Intro: the used span starts on bar 7, in the body (the track's quiet intro is bars 1-3, unused); no intro levelling.
Highs: spectral check of the used span: no tonal spike above 12 kHz (none over 6 dB in the long-term or high-band spectra); no notch.

Jingle A as built in m1 (news-open-1-mini-jingle, gain -3.1 dB = the event-loudness match to x11's horn computed by build-m1.sh, first big hit 0.660 s on frame 11, ducked -12 dB from 1.86 with a 1.0 s fade to silence). No stamps in this scene.
